title: Xiaoyaosan and isoliquiritigenin remodel depression-associated chromatin 3D structure and phase separation of NF-kappaB p65.
authors: Fan, Lili; Mo, Xiaowei; Dai, Ranran; Tang, Jingman; Wan, Chunmiao; Fang, Shaoyi; Zhou, Xuan; Ma, Qingyu; Zhuang, Xuxu; Chen, Yueyue; Li, Xiaojuan; Chen, Jiaxu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药逍遥散及异甘草素通过重塑染色质3D结构和NF-kappaB p65相分离缓解抑郁，涉及转录因子p65与DNA互作及分子对接，但核心是疾病机制而非TF-DNA结合建模，方法以实验为主、AI/物理模拟为辅。
abstract: Xiaoyaosan (XYS) is a classical traditional prescription with well-documented antidepressant effects. However, the active components and molecular mechanisms to alleviate depression remain unclear. In this study, using chronic social defeat stress (CSDS) and lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced depression models, we found that XYS and its key ingredient isoliquiritigenin (ILG) not only significantly improved depressive-like behaviors in mice but also exerted dual regulatory effects at the cellular level, promoting hippocampal neural stem cell proliferation and differentiation, while inhibiting microglia-mediated neuroinflammation. Using Hi-C technology, we discovered that XYS and ILG reversed the abnormal chromatin 3D structure in hippocampal microglia of depression models. Integrated analyses of transcriptomics, molecular docking, and 3D genomics identified the transcription factor p65 as a target of XYS and ILG. Co-culture experiments with microglia and neural stem cells further confirmed that overexpression of p65 promotes inflammation and inhibits neuronal growth. In depressed mice, NF-kappaB p65 expression was elevated and further formed phase separated condensates, which was effectively suppressed by XYS and ILG. This study reveals how XYS and its active component ILG function mechanistically to exert therapeutic effects on depression, including restoring chromatin 3D structure, and normalizing pathological phase separation of NF-kappaB p65, and reversing depressive phenotypes. Collectively, these findings provide a solid experimental foundation for the development of natural antidepressants.
abstract_zh: 逍遥散（XYS）是一种经典的传统方剂，具有充分记载的抗抑郁作用。然而，其缓解抑郁的活性成分和分子机制仍不清楚。在本研究中，利用慢性社交挫败应激（CSDS）和脂多糖（LPS）诱导的抑郁模型，我们发现XYS及其关键成分异甘草素（ILG）不仅显著改善了小鼠的抑郁样行为，还在细胞水平上发挥了双重调节作用，促进海马神经干细胞增殖和分化，同时抑制小胶质细胞介导的神经炎症。通过Hi-C技术，我们发现XYS和ILG逆转了抑郁模型海马小胶质细胞中异常的染色质三维结构。转录组学、分子对接和三维基因组学的整合分析确定了转录因子p65为XYS和ILG的靶点。小胶质细胞与神经干细胞的共培养实验进一步证实，p65的过表达促进炎症并抑制神经元生长。在抑郁小鼠中，NF-kappaB p65表达升高，并进一步形成相分离凝聚体，而XYS和ILG有效抑制了这一过程。本研究揭示了XYS及其活性成分ILG如何通过机制性作用发挥抗抑郁治疗效果，包括恢复染色质三维结构、正常化NF-kappaB p65的病理性相分离，以及逆转抑郁表型。总体而言，这些发现为天然抗抑郁药物的开发提供了坚实的实验基础。
